cover.headline: 1 fan beats 1,000 streams
cover.sub: Why one presale order pays you faster than a year of plays, and how to set one up.

blocks.text: Since April 2024, a Spotify track needs **1,000 streams in 12 months** before it earns recorded royalties at all. Below that, plays still count. The money doesn't.
Treat streams on a new release as discovery, not income.

left.title: Streams
left.text: Paid months later, if the track clears the bar.

right.title: Presale
right.text: Paid the moment the fan checks out.

blocks.text: Open a presale before the release date, not after it.
Example tiers. Give every fan a way in.

rungs.text: Signed vinyl and a thank-you note

blocks.text: Keep the cheapest tier under $15 so the first yes is easy.
Fans on your email list already raised a hand. Send them the presale **48 hours before** anyone else.
Add a signup form to your bio link before the presale opens.
